facts.fact: AIP reports ONECI deployed the Citiweb software in the mairies and sous-préfectures of the Gôh region, with all centres equipped at the end of 2025 and agent training under way since then, 44 agents trained in Gagnoa from 27 July 2026.
AIP reports the Citiweb software deployed by ONECI captures births, marriages and deaths in all mairie and sous-préfecture centres, equipped at the end of 2025.
